message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes of all time. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he rose to prominence as a high‑school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he was named the 2003 Mr. Basketball America and led his team to a state championship.

He entered the NBA directly from high school, being selected first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers in the 2003 draft. LeBron quickly became known for his combination of size, athleticism, basketball IQ, and versatility—he can play and guard multiple positions, score from inside and outside, and deliver exceptional passes.

**Career Highlights**

| Year | Team | Achievement |
|------|------|-------------|
| 2004 | Cleveland | NBA Rookie of the Year |
| 2006 | Cleveland | NBA Finals MVP (first Finals appearance) |
| 2010 | Miami Heat | NBA Champion (first title) |
| 2012 | Miami Heat | NBA Champion & Finals MVP |
| 2013 | Miami Heat | NBA Champion & Finals MVP |
| 2016 | Cleveland | NBA Champion (Cleveland’s first title in 52 years) |
| 2018 | Cleveland | NBA Finals appearance |
| 2020 | Los Angeles Lakers | NBA Champion & Finals MVP |
| 2021 | Los Angeles Lakers | NBA Champion |

LeBron has earned 18 All‑NBA selections, 17 All‑Defensive selections, and 4 NBA MVP awards (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013). He has also been selected to 19 All‑Star games and has won two Olympic gold medals with Team USA (2008, 2012).

**Off the Court**

- **Philanthropy:** The LeBron James Family Foundation, founded in 2003, focuses on education, providing scholarships and building the “I Promise” program to help at-risk youth in Akron.
- **Business Ventures:** He has a production company (SpringHill Entertainment), a partnership with Nike, and various endorsements.
- **Media & Advocacy:** LeBron has produced films and series, written a memoir, and spoken out on social justice issues, using his platform to advocate for voting rights, criminal justice reform, and educational equity.

**Legacy**

LeBron James is celebrated not only for his statistical dominance—over 38,000 career points and 10,000 assists—but also for his leadership, longevity, and impact on the game’s culture. He is often compared to Michael Jordan, and many consider him the best all‑round player ever. His influence extends beyond basketball, making him a global icon in sports, entertainment, and philanthropy.
